newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TABLE - Medex pre-excepts half yr shr rises.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Medex pre-excepts half yr shr rises.

text.p: (*) Included in operating income of 1.49 million rand is 6.7 million rand representing compensation received in respect of operations previously acquired that have underperformed. An additional amount of 3.3 million rand of compensation received has been treated as an exceptional item as it relates mainly to rationalisation costs necessarily incurred.

NOTE - The investment company said it intended to change its name to Index Capital Corp Ltd and apply to the Johannesburg Stock Exchange to change its listing from the pharmaceutical to the investment sector. This was expected to be completed by October 1997.
The company noted it had agreed to be part of a consortium to fund a casino at Gold Reef City subject to the successful granting of a casino licence.
